details:
Follow up on old post https://feedback.vrchat.com/feature-requests/p/friend-request-system-rework-needed-security

As streamer, you have much higher chance for sudden friend requests.

In old post, i already explained for change for system.

New players are not allowed to send already friend requests. There must some delay before it can turned on (it's same for world / avatar upload), at least some days until a week.

In old time, VRChat was at that time not very big. Friend requests are less risky and also much less misused by bad people. You can do it on website. Now in 2023 we have a lot people and it's one of the biggest VR places.

Which means it will attract also more bad people, crashers and rippers. But also people who don't agreed with your ways and will bully you ingame.

The website has own problem. Searching will show friends AND worlds. WHY? I don't need both at same time. The general search field is old system. Thanks to old system, so many people will easy searched this way. Too easy actually. I need toggle for this, not one field for everything.... You're just let servers work more partially for nothing.

The button is already there to send Friend request. No further steps needed, one click and it send already message.

I cannot believe it's too easy. We all know it's most time wrong with friend requests. This must change to make it less direct and easy. Otherwise you made the bots work easy for mass send requests. Add captcha or extra check steps so it will not more direct. 

And we need options for friend request system to setup for ourselves:

- option 1. allow friend request via website

- option 2. block friend request via website / must done only ingame

- option 3. only allow friend request if you're in same room as other person

- option 4. no friend requests allowed (its same as streamer mode)

I think send request on the website must have time delay. New players are locked on 1 hour interval. If you are more trusted, the interval will much shorter, but still minimal 1 minute interval as purple player.

You must realize when VRChat is getting bigger, the system will more abused by bad people to harass others. That is why it need a update to make it less easy. And give us more control over what we want with the system.

Thank you very much.
title: Friend Request system need change for security.
